hero.name: Al Baset
hero.description: Mechanical Engineering student at Chittagong University of Engineering and Technology (CUET) with hands-on experience in materials fabrication, CAD design, and engineering analysis. My research focuses on hybrid Al–Cu metal matrix composites reinforced with SiC and fly ash.
hero.photoCaption: At CUET — Department of Mechanical Engineering

paragraphs: I'm a final-year Mechanical Engineering student at Chittagong University of Engineering & Technology (CUET), graduating in July 2026 with a CGPA of 3.77 out of 4.00. I have a strong interest in materials engineering, design, manufacturing, and computational tools.

My final-year thesis investigates SiC and fly ash reinforcement in hybrid Al-Cu metal matrix composites, combining hands-on fabrication (stir casting) with mechanical and corrosion testing. I've also spent time on the ground at one of Bangladesh's largest power plants and at manufacturing facilities, which shapes how I think about design for real processes and real operating conditions.

I aspire to build a career in materials and mechanical engineering research, and I am currently exploring graduate study opportunities where I can apply engineering principles to solve practical problems.

research.lede: Fabrication, testing and analysis of a hybrid metal matrix composite.
research.title: Analysis of SiC and Fly Ash Reinforcement on Mechanical and Corrosion Behavior of Hybrid Al-Cu Matrix Composites
bullets: Fabricated hybrid Al-Cu-SiC-Fly ash metal matrix composites using the stir casting technique.
Evaluated mechanical and corrosion performance of the resulting composite samples.

experience.lede: Hands-on exposure to power generation and manufacturing industries.

main.site: Matarbari 2×600 MW Ultra-Super Critical Coal-Fired Power Plant (CPGCBL)
bullets: Completed a three-week industrial training program at one of Bangladesh's most advanced ultra-supercritical coal-fired power plants.
Gained hands-on exposure to power plant operations, maintenance practices, industrial safety, and major mechanical systems including boilers, turbines, generators, and pumps.
main.caption: Industrial training at Matarbari 2×600 MW Power Plant, CPGCBL

visits.desc: Gained practical exposure to refrigerator, air-conditioner, and PCB manufacturing processes, including assembly operations, production systems, and quality control procedures.

visits.site: S. Alam Cold Rolled Steels Limited
visits.desc: Observed cold-rolled steel manufacturing, boiler operations, and warehouse management systems, along with galvanized and corrugated sheet production processes.

Conducted assembly validation and motion analysis of the rotor mechanism.
Prepared engineering drawings and assembly documentation.
